story.titleZh: 凯迪拉克确认洛登离队并非双方协商一致
story.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队证实，格雷姆·洛登被解职并非双方协商一致的决定，且他仅在当天早上才得知此事。车队宣布由前阿尔派执行总监马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替洛登，担任2026赛季剩余时间及以后的车队负责人。

story.originalTitle: Cadillac confirms Lowdon's shock exit wasn't a "mutual decision"
story.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 has confirmed that Graeme Lowdon's dismissal as team principal was not a mutual decision, adding that he was only informed on the morning of the announcement. The team announced that former Alpine executive director Marcin Budkowski will replace Lowdon as team principal for the remainder of the 2026 season and beyond.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克证实洛登的意外离职并非“双方共同决定”
洛登直到消息公布当天早上才被告知即将发布的公告
Graeme Lowdon、Dan Towriss、Pat Symonds、凯迪拉克车队
凯迪拉克F1车队已证实，格雷姆·洛登被解除车队领队职务“并非双方共同决定”——并补充称他直到当天早上才被告知。
凯迪拉克周三发布了一则令人震惊的公告，宣布洛登已被前阿尔派执行董事马尔钦·布德科夫斯基取代，后者将执教2026赛季剩余比赛及之后。
这一消息公布时，正值这支美国车队在F1首个赛季的夏休期，他们在11轮比赛后排名垫底，一分未得。
但这在凯迪拉克的第一年基本在意料之中，最初人们认为洛登在帮助车队从零开始建立后，会长期留队。
然而，首席执行官丹·托里斯在与布德科夫斯基一同出席的媒体圆桌会议上证实，“这是我的决定”。布德科夫斯基自2022年1月离开阿尔派以来一直担任电视评论员。
“这不是一个双方共同做出的决定，”Towriss 确认道。“这个过程几个月前就开始了：真正思考凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的下一阶段是什么样子，什么时机合适，那会是什么样，然后还有外面各种人员的能力。”
Graeme Lowdon，凯迪拉克 F1 车队领队。
“我们很高兴与 Marcin 的交谈以及那段关系的发展。所以 Graeme 和我今天早上谈过，所以从这个角度来看，我认为这是一次非常近期的对话。
“但在 Formula 1 内部进行这种过渡没有容易的办法。你能想象如果 Marcin 闲逛着来参观工厂或进行这些对话，媒体会怎样吗？
“到那个时候就会变得不稳定，所以尊重当时在任领导层的意见很重要。”
“所以这确实压缩了决策过程、时间线以及这些事情如何凑到一起。这让事情感觉比原本会更突然。”
“但这就是F1的本质，也是它不得不发生的方式。”
考虑到这次解雇的突然性，社交媒体上出现了‘为什么是现在’的疑问，因此有人向Towriss提出，Lowdon是否只是以‘临时身份’在那里。
这位美国人回应道：“我认为说他是以临时身份在这里并不公平。这实际上是表现以及事情如何发展的结果。
“这些肯定会是格雷姆和我之间保留的讨论，关于哪些方面一致、哪些方面不一致。
“我能说的是，对于所取得的成就，我怀有极大的敬意。对我和格雷姆来说，这不是一个临时阶段，而几乎是长达四年的规划、建设以及完成所有环节的过程。
“因此，基于这项运动内部和车队内部现有的情况，这是正确的时机，所以这是向前迈出这一步的正确时机和正确地点。”
“正如你们所知，每当我们在F1中进行过渡时，这都是非常困难的。要让它保持安静是非常困难的，周围没有无数的泄密事件。”
“但我们现在在这里。我们再次非常感谢Graeme为车队带来的贡献，并对Marcin的领导力以及凯迪拉克的未来充满期待。”
detailEn: Cadillac confirms Lowdon's shock exit wasn't a "mutual decision"
Lowdon was only told about the forthcoming announcement on the morning of it happening
Graeme Lowdon, Dan Towriss, Pat Symonds, Cadillac Racing
The Cadillac Formula 1 outfit has confirmed that Graeme Lowdon’s dismissal as its team principal “wasn’t a mutual decision” - adding he was only told on the morning.
Cadillac made a shock announcement on Wednesday that Lowdon had been replaced by ex-Alpine executive director Marcin Budkowski for the rest of the 2026 campaign and beyond.
It came during the summer shutdown of the American squad’s debut season in F1, where it is bottom of the championship and without a point after 11 rounds.
But that was largely expected for Cadillac’s first year and it was initially assumed that Lowdon would continue with the team for the long-term after helping to build it from the ground-up.
However CEO Dan Towriss confirmed “it was my decision” during a media roundtable alongside Budkowski, who has been a television pundit since leaving Alpine in January 2022.

“It wasn't a mutual decision,” confirmed Towriss. “The process started a few months ago: really thinking about what the next phase for Cadillac Formula 1 looks like, what's the right timing, how would that look, and then the capabilities of the various folks out there.
Graeme Lowdon, Team Principal, Cadillac F1 Team.
“We were delighted in the conversation with Marcin and how that relationship evolved. So Graeme and I spoke this morning, so I think it is a very recent conversation from that perspective.
“But there's no easy way to make this transition within Formula 1. Can you imagine the press if Marcin strolled through for a tour of the factory or having these conversations?
“It becomes destabilising at that point and so it's important to respect the view of the leadership that's in place at that time.
“So it does compress the decision-making, the timeline and how these things come together. It makes it feel more abrupt than it would be otherwise.
“But it's the nature of Formula 1 and it's the way it had to happen.”
Considering the abrupt nature of the sacking, it led to questions on social media as to ‘why now’ and it was therefore put to Towriss if Lowdon was simply there in an “interim capacity”.
The American responded: “I don't think it's fair to say that he was here in an interim capacity. It really is a function of performance and how things evolved.
“Those are certainly going to be discussions that are going to be kept between Graeme and myself, as to where those aligned and where they didn't align.

“What I can say is, what was accomplished, I have immense respect for. This isn't an interim period for me and for Graeme, it's almost a four-year period of planning and building and doing all the pieces.
“So it was the right time based on the circumstances that exist both within the sport and within the team and so this is the right time and the right place to make that step going forward.
“Anytime we're making a transition in Formula 1, as you guys know, it's very difficult. It's very difficult to keep it quiet, that there weren't a myriad of leaks around that.
“But here we are. We're again very grateful to Graeme for what he brought to the team and very excited about Marcin’s leadership and what the future looks like for Cadillac.”
keyPointsZh: 这一决定是在夏季停摆期间做出的。
keyPointsEn: The decision was made during the summer shutdown.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.
